     5	// Figma Textfield flush variant (node 40000265:374): field/border/* tokens.
     6	// hover and filled (has value, unfocused) both darken to focus colour per Figma spec.
     7	const BORDER = {
     8	    default: cssVars.color.border.forms,  // #707070 — Figma field/border/default
     9	    hover:   cssVars.color.border.focus,  // #191919 — Figma field/border/hover
    10	    filled:  cssVars.color.border.focus,  // #191919 — Figma field/border/filled
    11	    focus:   cssVars.color.border.focus,  // #191919 — Figma field/border/focus
    12	    error:   cssVars.color.border.error,  // #9c0000 — Figma field/border/error
    13	} as const
    14	
    15	// Figma field/border/inverse/default = white (opaque), inverse/error = #f98f8c (coral).
    16	// Figma does not spec inverse/hover or inverse/focus separately — use same white.
    17	const BORDER_INVERSE = {
    18	    default: cssVars.color.text.inverse,           // white  — Figma field/border/inverse/default
    19	    hover:   cssVars.color.text.inverse,           // white  — Figma (not separately spec'd, same as default)
    20	    filled:  cssVars.color.text.inverse,           // white  — Figma (not separately spec'd)
    21	    focus:   cssVars.color.text.inverse,           // white  — Figma field/border/inverse/focus
    22	    error:   cssVars.color.status.errorBackground, // #f98f8c — Figma field/border/inverse/error
    23	} as const
    24	
    25	type UseZimmTextInputStateParams = {
    26	    inverse:   boolean
    27	    disabled:  boolean
    28	    hasError:  boolean
    29	    onChange?: (value: string) => void
    30	}
    31	
    32	type UseZimmTextInputStateReturn = {
    33	    value:        string
    34	    focused:      boolean
    35	    floated:      boolean
    36	    borderColour: string
    37	    /** hover border colour — used by the component to apply :hover via CSS (chakra sx) */
    38	    hoverBorderColour: string
    39	    labelColour:  string
    40	    inputRef:     React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>
    41	    handleChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void
    42	    handleClear:  () => void
    43	    setFocused:   React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>
    44	}
    45

    48	 * border/label colours aligned to Figma Textfield flush tokens (node 40000265:374).
    49	 * Hover border is no longer managed as JS state — the component applies it via

    51	 * @returns value, focus flag, derived visual tokens, inputRef, and event handlers
    52	 */
    53	export const useZimmTextInputState = ({
    54	    inverse,
    55	    disabled,
    56	    hasError,
    57	    onChange,
    58	}: UseZimmTextInputStateParams): UseZimmTextInputStateReturn => {
    59	    const [value,   setValue]   = useState('')
    60	    const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false)
    61	    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
    62	
    63	    const floated = focused || value.length > 0
    64	    const palette = inverse ? BORDER_INVERSE : BORDER
    65	
    66	    const borderColour = (() => {
    67	        if (disabled)         return palette.default
    68	        if (hasError)         return palette.error
    69	        if (focused)          return palette.focus
    70	        if (value.length > 0) return palette.filled
    71	        return palette.default
    72	    })()

    75	    // In all other states, hover darkens to focus colour — same value as focus itself.
    76	    const hoverBorderColour = hasError ? borderColour : palette.hover
    77	
    78	    // Figma text/subtle = #666 (colors.text.secondary) for floated/disabled label in light mode.
    79	    // Figma text/inverse/subtle = #969696 (colors.text.inverseGrey) for floated/disabled label in inverse mode.
    80	    const labelColour = (() => {

    82	        if (inverse)  return floated ? cssVars.color.text.inverseGrey : cssVars.color.text.inverse
    83	        return floated ? cssVars.color.text.secondary : cssVars.color.text.default
    84	    })()

    87	        setValue(e.target.value)
    88	        onChange?.(e.target.value)
    89	    }

    92	        setValue('')
    93	        onChange?.('')
    94	        inputRef.current?.focus()
    95	    }
    96	
    97	    return {
    98	        value, focused, floated,
    99	        borderColour, hoverBorderColour, labelColour,
